title: 7 Day Shira Route Kilimanjaro Climb
summary: A western Kilimanjaro camping route across the Shira Plateau, joining the southern circuit for Barranco, Karanga, Barafu and the summit.
overviewTitle: Why choose the 7 Day Shira Route?
overviewParagraphs: The Shira Route begins on Kilimanjaro's western side and crosses the broad Shira Plateau before joining the southern circuit.
The route uses mountain camps throughout and includes Lava Tower, Barranco Wall, Karanga, Barafu and a summit attempt from the east side of the mountain.
highlights: Western approach across the Shira Plateau
Seven mountain days with a local guide team

faqs.question: Where does the Shira Route begin?
faqs.answer: The climb approaches from the west through Londorossi Gate and crosses the Shira Plateau.

faqs.question: Does this route use huts?
faqs.answer: No. The Shira Route uses mountain camps and the crew prepares the tents and meals.
